name: SkyRL
summary: Modular reinforcement-learning stack with a training engine, long-horizon agent layer and Gymnasium-style tool-use environments for LLMs.
description: Public Apache-2.0 source. The unified skyrl library combines skyrl-train and skyrl-tx and supports a Tinker API backend on hardware you control. skyrl-agent handles multi-turn long-horizon training and evaluation; skyrl-gym supplies math, coding, search and SQL environments. Repository development and quickstart guides cover source setup and model/compute dependencies. The README documents Harbor integration and an October 16, 2026 Beam support recipe. This is software access, not free hosted GPU capacity.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
